0.original: This well-meaning mother has spread herself a little too thin.

24.original: Express /doubt as to what the children have been up to.

48.original: I swear, where did those boys run off to this time?

49.original: Excuse me, <hex:02080EE905FF056D697373FF0473697203>. I've searched everywhere and I can't find my boys. Would you help me look for them?

50.original: Work has kept me so busy I haven't been able to spend any time with them. Even when I do have a few moments to spare, they're always gone doing gods know what.

51.original: If you find them and they start making excuses, you'd be wise to <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>doubt<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> them. Still, they've never been the sort to get into trouble. <sigh> I hope they're okay.

52.original: They're sure to make up excuses to avoid getting in trouble, but I know my boys. If you show any <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>doubt<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> of their stories, they'll tell the truth.

53.original: Wh-What? Mother sent you to check on me? I haven't done anything bad, I promise.

54.original: I've been studying the plants and bugs out here. Someday I'm going to be a scholar, and make lots of money so Mother doesn't have to work so hard all the time.

55.original: I never meant to make her worry. I better go home and let her know I'm okay.

56.original: ...I've never seen wings like this on a bug before. I wonder why they're so different?

57.original: Mother sent you? She's always making a fuss over nothing.

58.original: I was just training is all. I'm going to join the Resistance, and defeat all the Garleans. Then she won't have to worry about anything ever again.

59.original: I wanted to practice a bit more before I told her, but I don't want her getting worked up over nothing. I should be heading back before she gets mad.

60.original: What do you want? Can't you see I'm busy practicing?

61.original: The boys are home, safe and sound. I don't know what you told them, but they certainly had a lot on their minds when they walked through the door.

62.original: They grow up so fast... I usually only ever see them when they're sleeping, but I looked into their eyes today and saw a fire that wasn't there before.

63.original: They've never known their father, but no matter how bad things got, I did everything I could to give them a happy childhood.

64.original: We'll be alright, you wait and see. I may look battered and beaten, but we mothers are made of sterner stuff. Our love for our children is the greatest strength there is.
